mo_ta: Khi them lenh, TP cua chuoi duoc dich theo (BlackDragon 'TP trailing treo len').
vet: Cot T/P cua cac lenh trong chuoi doi gia tri moi khi them lenh (can bang Orders co lenh sua).

engine.ghi_chu: luoi.py dat TP tu gia trung binh moi lan.

ap_cheo: Thuc chat giong tp_chuoi_tu_gia_tb khi TP tinh tu gia tb: co the da nam trong khoi nen.
rui_ro: Kho tach khoi tp_chuoi_tu_gia_tb neu khong co bang lenh sua.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
